typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Action as string,
		{Contact ID} as string,
		{Sched call Start date} as string,
		{Sched call Start Time} as string,
		{Promo ID} as string,
		{Call Reason} as string,
		{Account ID} as string,
		{Sched call ID} as string,
		{Sched call End date} as string,
		{Sched call End Time} as string,
		Language as string,
		RecordType as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_kpma_sch_calls*']) ~> source1
source(output(
		Id as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/sch_calls_group_id.csv']) ~> groupID
source(output(
		RecordTypeId as string,
		Name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/sch_calls_type_id.csv']) ~> RecordTypeId
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 split(isNull(Action)||not(in(['S', 'C'], upper(Action)))||isNull({Contact ID})||(isNull({Sched call Start date})&&(upper(Action)=='S'))||(isNull({Promo ID})&&(upper(Action)=='S'))||isNull({Call Reason})||(isNull({Sched call End date})&&(upper(Action)=='S'))||isNull({Sched call ID})&&(upper(Action) == 'C'),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(rejectCONDITION, toSFDC)
Join2 derive({Sched call Start date} = coalesce(toString(toDate({Sched call Start date}, 'yyyyMMdd')), {Sched call Start date}),
		{Sched call End date} = coalesce(toString(toDate({Sched call End date}, 'yyyyMMdd')), {Sched call End date}),
		{Account ID} = case(isNull({Account ID}), Id, {Account ID})) ~> DerivedColumn2
ConditionalSplit2@splitContact select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Process_Status__c = Action,
		Contact__c = {Contact ID},
		Call_date__C = {Sched call Start date},
		Start_Time__c = {Sched call Start Time},
		Promo_ID__c = {Promo ID},
		Description__c = {Call Reason},
		Sched_call_ID__c = {Sched call ID},
		Call_End_date__c = {Sched call End date},
		End_Time__c = {Sched call End Time}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: false,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: false) ~> Select1
ConditionalSplit1@rejectCONDITION derive(REJECT_REASON = concat(iif(not(in(['S', 'C'], upper(Action))),
           concat('ADF:INVALID Action. Expected ACTION_CODE = S or C. Received Action = "', iif(isNull(Action), 'NULL', Action), '"'), 
           ''),
        iif(isNull(Action)||isNull({Contact ID})||isNull({Call Reason})||isNull(Language), 
           concat('ADF:REQUIRED FIELD MISSING: ', iif(isNull(Action), 'Action ', ''), iif(isNull({Contact ID}), '{Contact ID} ', ''), iif(isNull({Call Reason}), '{Call Reason} ', '')), 
           ''), 
        iif((isNull({Sched call Start date})&&(upper(Action)=='S'))||(isNull({Sched call Start Time})&&(upper(Action)=='S'))||(isNull({Promo ID})&&(upper(Action)=='S'))||(isNull({Sched call End date})&&(upper(Action)=='S'))||(isNull({Sched call End Time})&&(upper(Action)=='S'))||(isNull(RecordType)&&(upper(Action) == 'S')),
           concat('ADF:REQUIRED FIELD MISSING FOR ACTION_CODE S: ', iif(isNull({Sched call Start date}), '{Sched call Start date} ', ''), iif(isNull({Promo ID}), '{Promo ID}', ''), iif(isNull({Sched call End date}), '{Sched call End date} ', ''), iif(isNull(RecordType), 'RecordType', '')),
           ''),
        iif(isNull({Sched call ID})&&(upper(Action) == 'C'), 'ADF:Required Field Missing: {Sched call ID}', ''))) ~> rejectREASON
rejectREASON select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
ConditionalSplit1@toSFDC, groupID join(1 == 1,
	joinType:'left',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'right')~> Join1
Join1, RecordTypeId join(RecordType == Name,
	joinType:'left',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'right')~> Join2
DerivedColumn2 split(startsWith({Contact ID}, '003'),
	startsWith({Contact ID}, '00Q'),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit2@(splitContact, splitLead)
ConditionalSplit2@splitLead select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Process_Status__c = Action,
		Lead_ID__c = {Contact ID},
		Call_date__C = {Sched call Start date},
		Start_Time__c = {Sched call Start Time},
		Promo_ID__c = {Promo ID},
		Description__c = {Call Reason},
		Sched_call_ID__c = {Sched call ID},
		Call_End_date__c = {Sched call End date},
		End_Time__c = {Sched call End Time}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select3
Select1, Select3 union(byName: true)~> Union1
DerivedColumn1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_kpma_sch_calls_raw.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> intermOUTPUT
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_kpma_sch_calls_source_reject.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> rejectOUTPUT
Union1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_kpma_sch_calls_Staging_Inbound_Campaign__c.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insertS
